integrity: The infinite statement follows from a symbolic positivity proof for the L-space Alexander staircase combined with the published homological-monodromy argument. No finite experiment is used to infer the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The result resolves only the sign of the dilatation root in the specific lens-surgery threshold case. It does not compute the dilatation, prove root simplicity, classify the remaining Alexander roots, or treat other surgery slopes.
title: Forced negative dilatation root at the \(4g-2\) lens-surgery threshold
